{{Quote|And finally, we'll gut the ion drives and refit the bracings with these three military grade KonGar KGDefender ion engines.|[[Bolabo Hujaan]], preparing to modify the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]|<ref name="All the Extras">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=All the Extras}}</ref>}}
The '''KGDefender ion engine''' was a military-grade [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] produced by [[KonGar Ship Works]]. [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar's]] [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Outrider/Legends|Outrider]]'' was equipped with three KGDefender ion engines which had been stolen<ref name="EGVV" /> and fitted by [[Bolabo Hujaan]].<ref name="All the Extras" />
